title: Volatility 3 memory forensics
preconditions: symbols available for the OS build
steps: `vol -f mem.raw windows.info` (or `linux.pslist`) to identify the OS/profile; download matching symbols if needed.
`windows.pslist`, `pstree`, `psscan`, `cmdline`, `netscan`, `malfind`, `dlllist`, `handles`; compare pslist vs psscan for hidden processes.
Dump suspicious processes/files with `--dump`/`dumpfiles`; extract strings and scan with YARA.
falsifier: Wrong profile/symbols produce empty plugin output; confirm the OS build before concluding the dump is clean.
